name: Womancart Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2018, Womancart Ltd is in the business of women's clothing, jewellery, makeup, and accessories, etc.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2][3]
WCL is a digital consumer-centric retail platform offering a wide range of classic and emerging branded beauty and wellness products for skin care, body care, hair care, and fragrance for both men and women. It also features lifestyle brands, including makeup, imitation jewellery, and lingerie. Company also runs brick-and-mortar stores to allow customers to interact with the brand. Currently, company has 12,000+  SKUs, 9+ Stores & Warehouses, 7+  Own Brands[4]

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Promoter holding has decreased over last quarter: -1.33%
Working capital days have increased from 145 days to 228 days
